segments.text: At Deepwater Anchorage, Juno dug the Meridian's Hope distress beacon out of the anchorage's signal archive. The capture was clipped, its origin coordinates scrubbed on purpose.
Vesna ran the clipped signal against the Lantern Wake's star charts, and the source was not the colony ship at all, but Varga Relay, dark for a generation and still repeating the call.
Vesna threaded the Lantern Wake through the ice of Kessel Drift, and the ship came out the far side with the relay on the forward scopes.
Vesna parked the Lantern Wake in the relay's sensor shadow, close enough to see the scorched docking collar.
Who scrubbed the coordinates was unknown, and why a dead relay still spoke. One row of the station's windows was lit.
